title: Find it on the keys
summary: Tap the key: by ear, any spelling, or the exact key.
content:
## The keyboard

The white keys are C D E F G A B, again and again. The black keys sit between them: the one between C and D is C sharp, also called D flat.

## Finding a note

Tap a key to hear it. The last key you tap before Check is your answer.

quiz.explanation: It was E, the white key just right of the second black key in a group of two.

quiz.prompt: Find the note you hear. It is a black key.
quiz.explanation: B flat is the black key between A and B; it is also called A sharp.

quiz.prompt: Find this C on the keys.
quiz.explanation: The C in the third space of the treble staff is the C above middle C.
hints: Middle C sits on a line of its own below the staff.
